posts.author: elpsykongroo
posts.body:
Hello friends!  I am running into some trouble: I have a character I want to do an idle animation in on a map.  I have the sprite sheet set up correctly: the 0-1-2-1-0 setup, but when I click "stepping" and run the game, the character is stagnant.
I have the event as "same as character" "fixed" and "action button", as theirs dialogue when the player interacts.  Any help as to why there might be an issue there?  Would a "set event location" event be an issue?  Hopefully you much smarter people can help!
Thank you for reading!

posts.author: Zia_
posts.body:
What do you mean by "0-1-2-1-0 setup"? A character is arranged as "left, mid, right" on a charset.
In general, you don't have to do anything special except clicking the "Stepping" checkbox to make them step.

posts.body: Hard to say without seeing the sheet.

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
are you using any plugins? do you have any other events on the map that may be manipulating this one? if you wanted the character to to be looking around, then youve set up the sheet correctly.
also as a note, you shouldnt have spaces in your asset names. You can use an underscore in place of the spaces or use or Pascal case. The file names should be URL compliant to avoid loading issues later. i doubt itd cause this issue, but just something to keep in mind

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
direction fix checkbox make it so, that it won't turn direction ever.
however, it should do the stepping animation (for events).
so checking "stepping" to ON (checked) should work by default.
I'm not sure what the "walking" does, but stepping should be checked.
else show the entire event page.

posts.body: If so you need to stop it once change location is done. Either use a variables and conditional branch or erase the event.

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body: No if you come back erased events will also come back. If it is one time use, a self switch is more ideal. Just use an empty page to simulate 'erase'.
